quantisation: per-dimension symmetric: scale[d] = max_i |v_id| / 127; q = round(v / scale[d]), range -127..127

embed.note: no query/instruction prefix: gapfind compares text with text; max 512 tokens

recipe.vector: v = normalize(embedding - mean)   // mean from live_index.json, then re-normalise
recipe.index: row i of live_index.bin (int8, row-major, dims columns) = round(vec_i / scale[d]); dequantise x_id = q_id * scale[d]; use cosine, i.e. divide each dequantised row by its L2 norm (precompute once at load)
recipe.exclude_self: only when validating on corpus items; a new report has no self row
recipe.position: p = normalize(sum_j w_j * xyz_j), xyz_j = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) of neighbour j from globe.json; lat = asin(p.z), lon = atan2(p.y, p.x)
recipe.facet_guess: majority vote among the 8 neighbours' tags (ties: larger summed weight); vote share is the reliability signal (see validation.facet_guess.<axis>.by_vote_share)

validation.protocol: leave-one-out over all 1563 corpus items: query = the item's float bge-small vector, index = the int8 dequantised corpus without the item itself, 8 nearest by cosine; error = great-circle degrees between the placed position and the item's true globe position

by_neighbour_agreement.definition: R = |sum_j w_j xyz_j| / sum_j w_j, computed in the browser before normalising; R near 1 means the neighbours sit together on the globe, low R means they are scattered and the placed point is a compromise

validation.selection_note: weights/variant picked by lowest median error on this same leave-one-out run (2 variants x 5 schemes, 1-2 free parameters); expect the honest error to be a little above it
validation.caveat: corpus items have near-duplicates and same-source siblings among their neighbours (see by_top1_similarity); a genuinely new report resembles the corpus less, so use the lowest-similarity stratum as the pessimistic number. Browser embeddings come from the Xenova ONNX export, fastembed's index from Qdrant's quantised ONNX: same weights and pooling, small numeric differences, not measured here.

selftest.note: vector = the float query vector AFTER the recipe's centering/normalising step (i.e. what is dotted with the dequantised, row-normalised index); skip row skip_row; lat/lon = expected placement, true_lat/true_lon = where globe.json puts the item
